// Loading something (from a file, or an API through the site's own server function): the page shows a loading
// state, then the result, an empty state when there is nothing, or an error state with Try again.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export type AsyncState<T> =
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'ready'; data: T }
  | { status: 'error'; message: string }

export function useAsync<T>(load: () => Promise<T>): AsyncState<T> & { retry: () => void } {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AsyncState<T>>({ status: 'loading' })
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    setState({ status: 'loading' })
    load().then(
      (data) => {
        if (alive) setState({ status: 'ready', data })
      },
      (err: unknown) => {
        if (alive) setState({ status: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) })
      },
    )
    return () => {
      alive = false
    }
  }, [load, attempt])

  const retry = useCallback(() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1), [])
  return { ...state, retry }
}
